elements.description: A blurred colour gradient glowing up from the bottom edge, behind its children.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Gradient from the crest down: [top, middle, bottom]

properties.name: speed
properties.description: Seconds per morph loop; 0 keeps the shape still (the sideways drift keeps going)

properties.name: playFor
properties.description:
Seconds of motion before the floor slows down and rests (rounded to whole drift loops of 2.5 s); Infinity never
stops – then give users a way to pause it (WCAG 2.2.2)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"
